COLDWAR_CMEA_D5_apply = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_done_D5 } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_CMEA D5 in force"
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_done_D5
		# once only: the EC declaration (D8) may have put it into force already (the flag above is set first, so the EC side does not call back)
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_c_HM = 0.02 }
		if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -1 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_ec_trade
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_c_WE = 0.03 }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_cw_dirty
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_done_D5
		# the same declaration of the European Communities (EC file D8) enters into force with it
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_initialized NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_D8 } }
			COLDWAR_EC_D8_apply = yes
		}
	}
}

			array = global.cwcm_members
			CHI = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_D6_chi } }

	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized } set_temp_variable = { mdcw_cw_tension_delta = -1 } mdcw_cw_add_tension = yes }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_c_PP = -0.02 }
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_done_D6
}

# Country scope (member). Takes part in the recommendation B6 from now on (full price, gain from now).
COLDWAR_CMEA_B6_join = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_rec_B6
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B6 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B6
		COLDWAR_CMEA_special_western_credit_c = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_special_western_debt_c = yes
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_ZI = 0.1 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Ends the part in B6 (the country leaves the Council).
COLDWAR_CMEA_B6_leave = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B6 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_B6
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_ZI = -0.1 }
	}
}

COLDWAR_CMEA_C1_leave = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C1 }
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C1
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_ZP = -0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_FO = -0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_HM = -0.03 }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_BK = -0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_PP = 0.02 }
	}
}

# Country scope (member). Takes part in the recommendation C2 from now on (full price, gain from now).
COLDWAR_CMEA_C2_join = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_rec_C2
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C2 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_in_C2
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_IND = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_IB = 0.05 }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_KG = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_m_BK = 0.01 }
	}
}

# Country scope (passive member). Takes part in every recommendation in force (credits are not taken over).
COLDWAR_CMEA_join_all_recommendations = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C1_join = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C2_join = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C3_join = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C4_join = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C5_join = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C6_join = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C7_join = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_country = yes
}

# Country scope. A leaving member keeps nothing of the recommendations and programmes.
COLDWAR_CMEA_clear_participation = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_B6_leave = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C1_leave = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C2_leave = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C3_leave = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C4_leave = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C5_leave = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C6_leave = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_C7_leave = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_clear_programmes = yes
}

# Country scope (player member). Join: takes part in the recommendation in temp cwcm_t_item.
COLDWAR_CMEA_join_ctx = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_item = 26 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_B6_join = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_item = 41 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_C1_join = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_item = 42 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_C2_join = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_item = 43 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_C3_join = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_item = 44 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_C4_join = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_item = 45 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_C5_join = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_item = 46 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_C6_join = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_item = 47 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_C7_join = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_country = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. The Council dissolves (Budapest 1991): every member leaves without a cooling-off period, programmes and files close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_dissolve = {
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_dissolved
	clear_temp_array = cwcm_t_all
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		add_to_temp_array = { cwcm_t_all = THIS }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwcm_t_all
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } COLDWAR_CMEA_leave_member = yes clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_rejoin_cooldown }
	}
	# programmes, offices and files close
	COLDWAR_CMEA_q1_end = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_q2_end = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_q3_end = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_q4_end = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_free = yes
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_pres = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_com = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_dirty = 1 }
}

# Any scope. Text only: the open accounts close with the dissolution.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_dissolve_price = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_CMEA dissolution: accounts closed"
}

# Any scope. Every member pays its share of the bank capital.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_iib_capital = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_iib_capital = yes
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Capital of the International Investment Bank: 0.2 % of GDP once.
COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_iib_capital = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_iib_paid } }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -0.002 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_iib_paid
	}
}

# Any scope. Oil importers pay more under the annual formula.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_importers_one_year = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer }
				add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_t_B2 days = 365 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. World prices hit the oil importers.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_importers_shock = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_importer }
				add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_CMEA_t_B5 days = 730 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. IIB credit to the member in the context.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_loan = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_start_loan = yes
}

# Any scope. Western credit line for the participants.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_western_credit = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } COLDWAR_CMEA_special_western_credit_c = yes }
	}
}

# Any scope. Text only (booked with the credit).
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_western_debt = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_CMEA western debt booked with the credit"
}

# Country scope. Treasury +1 % of GDP, debt +1.2 % of GDP (Western banks), the United States approve.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_western_credit_c = {
	set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = 0.01 }
	modify_treasury_effect = yes
	set_temp_variable = { debt_change = gdp_total }
	multiply_temp_variable = { debt_change = 0.012 }
	modify_debt_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { country_exists = USA NOT = { tag = USA } } USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_B6_usa } } }
}

# Country scope. Text only (booked with the credit).
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_western_debt_c = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_CMEA western debt"
}

# Any scope. The clearing is shared anew.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_shared_deliveries = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
}

# Any scope. Co-operation agreement with the country in the context.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_cooperation = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = {
			COLDWAR_CMEA_become_associate = yes
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_partner } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Observer status for the country in the context.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_observer = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target > 0 }
			var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwcm_ctx_target = {
			COLDWAR_CMEA_become_observer = yes
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				PREV = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = PREV modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_partner } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. The United States resent Yugoslavia joining the Council.
COLDWAR_CMEA_special_usa_ser = {
	if = { limit = { country_exists = USA country_exists = SER } USA = { add_opinion_modifier = { target = SER modifier = COLDWAR_CMEA_op_D4_usa } } }
}
